name: Badge
structurePatterns: dot: an 8px filled circle positioned at the top-right of an icon/avatar
count: a pill with min 18x18, single-digit centered, values 1-99 then 99+; white 2px ring separates from host
typically overlays an icon button, bottom navigation item, or avatar
brand tone for counts; attention (danger) tone for critical alerts
usageHints: count range is 1-99, display 99+ beyond that
do not stack dot, count, and text alert on the same target
critical meaning requires a text equivalent for accessibility
doNotInvent: no large badges with long text
